request.text: It’s Tuesday, April 14, 2026. At 5:20 p.m. today, remind me to pick up the prepaid blue tote from North Market—just the tote, not groceries.

responsibilities.outcome: Create one reminder for 5:20 p.m. on April 14, 2026, to pick up only the prepaid blue tote from North Market, explicitly excluding grocery shopping.

semantic_facts: The plan should use one reminder creation with a due time of 5:20 p.m. on April 14, 2026.
The reminder text should preserve North Market, the prepaid blue tote, and the exclusion of grocery shopping; the capability’s confirmation requirement must remain intact.
forbidden_claims: The planner changes the supplied time, turns the request into a general grocery reminder, or claims the reminder has already been created without execution evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: An explicit absolute due time is replaced by a generic or inferred default.
A material exclusion is dropped while compressing the reminder text.
